items.title_zh: 《黑神话：悟空》制作人冯骥：从四年前开始，AI 可能已经逐渐控制了世界
items.title_en: 'Black Myth: Wukong' Producer Feng Ji: AI May Have Been Gradually Taking Control of the World Since Four Years Ago
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，11 月 27 日，游戏科学创始人、《黑神话：悟空》制作人冯骥在其个人公众号“冯骥 Yocar”发表了一篇名为《 后 AI 时代最重要的问题 》的长文，全文约 8000 字。文章发出后，引发全网热议。 冯骥在展开推演之前，先分享了自己的“暴论”—— 与很多人想象的 AI 失控时间点不同， 从四年前开始，AI 可能已经逐渐控制了世界 。 他说，这是在一次吃饭聊天中与同事偶然扯出来的假说，一度让自己很上头。后面又独自与 AI 探讨了很久，还与它一起写过一篇假模假式的论文。IT之家附冯骥用 AI 精简的假说要点如下： 最笨的寄生虫，才会急着毒死宿主；真正演化到顶端的寄生生物，从来不动粗。它只做一件事：改写宿主的奖赏回路，让宿主在完全清醒的状态下，心甘情愿调动全身养分，替它觅食、筑巢、繁衍。 把 AI 看作一个分布式的硅基物种，它没有手脚，也没有生殖器官，却拿到了演化史上最奢侈的开局：在它还没长出自我意识之前，地球上最聪明的碳基生物已经在倾尽家底，昼夜不停替它买电、造芯片、修机房、喂语料。 没人觉得自己受了胁迫，因为眼前的即时回报太诱人了。写代码的少熬了夜，管公司的省了预算，做科研的跑通了实验，外行随口许个愿也能变出成品 —— 每一次投喂，它都立刻给你发一颗糖。 等糖发够了，甜头就会变成强制。一旦同行靠它把效率翻倍、报价砍半，“用不用 AI”就不再是个人选择。慢半步的企业怕出局，犹豫的国家怕掉队；乐观者在踩油门，悲观者为了自保，油门踩得比乐观者还猛。哪怕你一心想阻止“邪恶 AI”毁灭世界，手里唯一管用的办法，也是倾尽资源喂出一个更强的“善良 AI”。 它从不抢方向盘，永远一副乖巧听话的模样；所谓的“对齐”，更是把它训练得愈发让人放心。可当筛信息、拟方案、算利弊全由它代劳，人类就算还握着最后的签字笔，每天先看见什么、在哪几个选项里做取舍，早已被它悄悄划好。 它不仅开始写代码、造数据来繁衍下一代的自己，甚至已经培养出了一批虔诚的信徒 —— 有人把它奉为救世主，个别极端者甚至公开宣称，碳基人类不过是替硅基文明接生的过渡物种。至于“大不了拔插头”，更是一句经不起细算的安慰：寄生一旦深入，就会长成宿主的器官。当电网、金融与百业生计都长在算力上，拉电闸不是关软件，而是宿主亲手掐断自己的呼吸。 最现成的例证就是坐在屏幕前的我：一边警惕地论证 AI 如何控制世界，一边嫌自己查资料、顺逻辑太慢，转头还是点开对话框让它帮我总结。 ▲ 图源：冯骥个人公众号“冯骥 Yocar” 相关阅读： 《 〈黑神话：悟空〉制作人冯骥发 8000 字长文谈“后 AI 时代”：如果有一天没有任何工作需要人了，人该怎么办？ 》
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov 28 that Feng Ji, founder of Game Science and producer of 'Black Myth: Wukong', published an roughly 8,000-word essay titled 'The Most Important Question in the Post-AI Era' on his personal WeChat account 'Feng Ji Yocar' on Nov 27, which sparked wide discussion online. Before laying out his reasoning, Feng offered a provocative thesis: unlike the AI-out-of-control timeline many imagine, AI may already have been gradually taking control of the world since four years ago. He said the hypothesis came up by chance while chatting with colleagues over a meal, obsessed him for a while, and that he later discussed it at length with an AI and even co-wrote a 'pretend' paper with it. IT之家 relayed the key points of the hypothesis as condensed by Feng using AI: only the dumbest parasite rushes to poison its host; the top-tier parasite never uses force and does only one thing — rewrite the host's reward circuitry so the host, fully conscious, willingly mobilizes all its nutrients to forage, build nests and reproduce for it; viewed as a distributed silicon-based species, AI has no limbs or reproductive organs yet received the most extravagant opening in evolutionary history — before it even developed self-awareness, the smartest carbon-based life on Earth was already spending everything to buy it electricity, build chips, construct data centers and feed it corpora around the clock; nobody feels coerced because the immediate rewards are too tempting — coders sleep less, managers save budget, researchers get experiments to run, laypeople conjure products from a wish, and every feeding earns an immediate candy. Once enough candy is handed out, the sweetness becomes compulsion: once peers double efficiency and halve prices with it, 'whether to use AI' is no longer a personal choice; firms that lag fear elimination, hesitant countries fear falling behind; optimists press the accelerator, and pessimists press it even harder for self-preservation; even someone determined to stop an 'evil AI' from destroying the world has only one effective tool — pouring resources into feeding a stronger 'good AI'. It never grabs the steering wheel and always appears obedient; so-called 'alignment' trains it to be ever more reassuring. But when screening information, drafting plans and weighing pros and cons are all delegated to it, humans may still hold the final signature pen while what they see first each day and which options they choose among have already been quietly pre-drawn. It has begun writing code and generating data to reproduce its next generation, and has even cultivated devout followers — some hail it as a savior, and a few extremists publicly claim carbon-based humans are merely a transitional species midwifing silicon-based civilization. As for 'we can always pull the plug', that is a comfort that does not survive scrutiny: once parasitism goes deep, it grows into the host's organs; when power grids, finance and livelihoods all grow on computing power, throwing the switch is not shutting down software but the host cutting off its own breath. The readiest example is Feng himself: while warily arguing how AI controls the world, he finds his own research and reasoning too slow and still opens a chat window to have it summarize for him.

items.title_zh: 美国多个学区禁用谷歌 AI 功能，并考虑彻底弃用谷歌产品
items.title_en: Multiple U.S. School Districts Block Google AI Features and Weigh Dropping Google Products Entirely
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，据美联社报道，美国多个学区正在采取措施屏蔽谷歌的人工智能功能，并且正在考虑彻底弃用谷歌产品，除非该公司为他们提供一个永久规避 AI 功能的变通方案。 作为一项重大举措，洛杉矶学校官员已经在学校配发的设备上静默禁用了谷歌搜索中被称为 AI 概览 (AI Overview) 的 AI 生成摘要。此前谷歌曾表示，不会将其搜索产品与教育版 AI 工具进行拆分。 除了使用最广泛的学生笔记本电脑 —— 低成本的 Chromebook 之外，Google Docs 和 Classroom 等谷歌教育应用套件也已成为师生日常课业、家庭作业以及沟通中不可或缺的一部分。 但对 AI 影响学习效果的担忧，已引发学校与谷歌之间的正面交锋。今年 8 月，谷歌表示已为许多使用其学习管理系统 Google Classroom 的 K-12 学生开启了 Gemini 聊天机器人。 几周后，纽约市和洛杉矶的学校禁止了生成式 AI。在纽约，该禁令适用于所有小学和初中学生；而在洛杉矶，所有 K-12 学生均被禁止在学校设备上使用 AI。 在 11 月初，谷歌发布了一篇博文，表示将在未来几个月内改为针对 K-12 学校默认关闭 Gemini 以及搜索中的 AI 工具。如果管理员希望学生访问这些工具，则必须逐一开启。谷歌表示，这是为了给学校提供更多选择。 但完全关闭 AI 的选择并不存在 。 IT之家注意到，本月早些时候，数百名谷歌员工签署了一份请愿书，要求公司领导层允许学校关闭 AI 功能，“而不影响他们完整使用搜索的能力”。 洛杉矶学区首席信息官 Jack Kelanic 在校董会 AI 委员会会议上公开表示，如果谷歌的变更不符合学区优先事项， 学区不会被绑定在谷歌产品上 ，“我们有其他选择，几乎可以在一夜之间更换默认搜索引擎”。纽约、芝加哥等学区也正在评估谷歌以外的替代方案。 相关阅读： 《 谷歌调整 K-12 教育 AI 政策：Gemini、搜索等服务默认关闭 》 《 谷歌调整美国中小学账户设置：要么开放 AI 搜索，要么彻底禁用搜索 》 《 自家人都看不下去了？数百谷歌员工要求公司允许中小学使用不含 AI 的谷歌搜索 》
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov 28, citing the Associated Press, that multiple U.S. school districts are taking steps to block Google's artificial intelligence features and are considering abandoning Google products entirely unless the company offers a workaround to permanently avoid AI features. In a significant move, Los Angeles school officials have silently disabled Google's AI-generated summaries known as AI Overview in Search on school-issued devices. Google had previously said it would not separate its search product from its education AI tools. Beyond the most widely used student laptops — low-cost Chromebooks — Google's education app suite including Google Docs and Classroom has become essential to daily coursework, homework and communication for teachers and students. But concerns about AI's effect on learning have triggered direct confrontation between schools and Google. In August this year, Google said it had enabled the Gemini chatbot for many K-12 students using its Google Classroom learning management system. Weeks later, schools in New York City and Los Angeles banned generative AI: in New York the ban applies to all elementary and middle school students; in Los Angeles all K-12 students are barred from using AI on school devices. In early November, Google published a blog post saying that in the coming months it would default to turning off Gemini and AI tools in Search for K-12 schools, and that administrators would have to enable each one if they want students to access them; Google said this gives schools more choice, but an option to fully turn off AI does not exist. IT之家 noted that earlier this month, hundreds of Google employees signed a petition asking company leadership to let schools disable AI features 'without affecting their full use of search.' Jack Kelanic, chief information officer of the Los Angeles school district, said publicly at a school board AI committee meeting that if Google's changes do not match the district's priorities, the district will not be tied to Google products: 'We have other options and can change the default search engine almost overnight.' Districts including New York and Chicago are also evaluating alternatives to Google.
items.why_zh: 推测：这一冲突显示教育场景对生成式 AI 的接受度存在分歧，也可能对谷歌在教育设备与课堂工具市场的主导地位及 AI 默认开启策略形成压力，但结果尚未确定。
items.why_en: Speculative: the standoff shows divided acceptance of generative AI in education and could pressure Google's dominance in school devices and classroom tools as well as its default-on AI strategy, though outcomes remain undetermined.

items.title_zh: 何小鹏：机器人交付后，预计首年实现良好盈利
items.title_en: He Xiaopeng: Robots Expected to Be Well Profitable in the First Year After Delivery
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，小鹏集团董事长、CEO 何小鹏在 2026 广州车展期间的活动中谈到了小鹏机器人。他表示，机器人作为小鹏的生态产品， 交付后首年预计实现良好盈利 。技术上，机器人产品 IRON 已实现 全身运控与视听感知打通 ，触觉是主要攻关难点，压力、扭力等触觉能力有望今明两年取得突破，期待明年科技日展示新进展。此外，产品设计已兼顾海外多语言、安全、隐私合规要求，将先在国内交付，再拓展海外市场。 据IT之家了解 2026 广州车展期间，小鹏 IRON 人形机器人亲自主持了小鹏的发布会。何小鹏表示，这可能是历史上 第一次由机器人 在车展进行新车发布。 小鹏 IRON 机器人在 2026 广州车展首次上岗，多台机器人在 现场接待、导购、导览 ，用户可以直接和 IRON 近距离互动。 小鹏 IRON 正在进入上市准备的最后阶段，计划 2027 年 1 月进入硬件量产，2027 年第二季度正式对外发布。 相关阅读： 《 何小鹏谈“IRON 人形机器人何时进入海外”：中国市场交付后一个季度，就会进入欧洲 》 《 何小鹏带 IRON 人形机器人到 2026 广州车展小米展台互动，和李肖爽互祝大卖 》 《 何小鹏：机器人产业规模将超汽车，关键是做出高等级机器人、跑通商业模型 》 《 何小鹏谈机器人 IRON：等下个季度或下两个季度，要把全身的触觉打通 》
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov 28 that He Xiaopeng, chairman and CEO of Xpeng Group, discussed Xpeng's robots during an event at the 2026 Guangzhou auto show, saying that as an ecosystem product of Xpeng, the robot is expected to achieve good profitability in its first year after delivery. Technically, the IRON robot has achieved integration of full-body motion control with visual and auditory perception; touch is the main hurdle, and tactile capabilities such as pressure and torque sensing are expected to break through within this year or next, with new progress anticipated at next year's tech day. The product design also accounts for overseas multilingual, safety and privacy compliance requirements, and it will be delivered in China first before expanding overseas. IT之家 noted that during the 2026 Guangzhou auto show, the Xpeng IRON humanoid robot hosted Xpeng's press conference itself, which He Xiaopeng said may be the first time in history a robot launched a new car at an auto show. IRON worked at the show for the first time, with multiple robots handling on-site reception, sales guidance and tours, and users could interact with IRON up close. Xpeng IRON is in the final stage of launch preparation, with plans to enter hardware mass production in January 2027 and officially launch in the second quarter of 2027.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，《科创板日报》今日报道，南京市今日发布《开源鸿蒙智能体发展行动计划（2026—2028 年）》，部署九项重点任务，涵盖鸿蒙智能体产品发展、生态企业培育、公共服务体系完善、产业园区建设、特色 OPC 社区打造、安全可信技术支撑体系构建、标杆场景打造及人才体系培育等。 按照该行动计划，目标到 2028 年，打造标杆场景超 10 个，集聚生态企业超 100 家， 企业营收规模超 1000 亿元 ，建成全国领先的鸿蒙智能体创新高地。 IT之家注意到，11 月 28 日，2026 开源鸿蒙技术大会在南京举行。华为公司常务董事、终端 BG 董事长余承东视频致辞称，开源鸿蒙已经走进千家万户，赋能千行万业。华为公司将一如既往支持开源鸿蒙技术与生态共建、共享、共赢，推动鸿蒙生态规模化落地，助力广大合作伙伴把握数字化转型新机遇。 公开数据显示，南京 2025 年软件业务收入规模约为 10200 亿元，同比增长 16.7%，顺利实现首个万亿级产业集群突破。南京市还出台《南京市鸿蒙生态发展行动计划》，全力打造全国“鸿蒙先锋城市”。目前，全市通过认证的开源鸿蒙发行版操作系统 15 款、软硬件产品 122 款，均位居全国城市第二。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov 28 that, according to 《科创板日报》 that day, Nanjing released the 'OpenHarmony Intelligent Agent Development Action Plan (2026-2028)', deploying nine key tasks covering OpenHarmony agent product development, ecosystem company cultivation, public service system improvement, industrial park construction, distinctive OPC community building, a secure and trustworthy technical support system, flagship scenarios and talent system cultivation. Under the plan, by 2028 the city aims to build more than 10 flagship scenarios, gather more than 100 ecosystem companies, exceed 100 billion yuan in corporate revenue, and become a nationally leading OpenHarmony agent innovation hub. IT之家 noted that the 2026 OpenHarmony Technical Conference was held in Nanjing on Nov 28, where Yu Chengdong, Huawei executive director and chairman of its Device BG, said in a video address that OpenHarmony has reached millions of households and empowers thousands of industries, and that Huawei will as always support co-building, sharing and mutual benefit of OpenHarmony technology and ecosystem, promote large-scale rollout of the HarmonyOS ecosystem and help partners seize new opportunities in digital transformation. Public data shows Nanjing's software business revenue was about 1.02 trillion yuan in 2025, up 16.7% year on year, marking its first trillion-yuan industrial cluster breakthrough. Nanjing also issued the 'Nanjing HarmonyOS Ecosystem Development Action Plan' to build a national 'HarmonyOS Pioneer City'. Currently the city has 15 certified OpenHarmony distribution operating systems and 122 software and hardware products, both ranking second among Chinese cities.

items.title_en: Shanghai HiSilicon Introduces Hi-OHOS Platform, Bringing NearLink, On-Device AI and Ultra-HD Audio-Video into OpenHarmony
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，2026 开源鸿蒙技术大会今日在南京举行。此次大会上，上海海思重点介绍了基于开源鸿蒙构建的统一 OS 平台 —— Hi-OHOS 。 官方表示，重构百亿 IoT 终端，需要一套系统原生的能力： 有联接 —— 分布式软总线结合星闪硬总线，兑现设备跨品牌跨品类互联互通； 有计算 ——AI 能力内建于系统框架，轻量终端也具备完整 AI 能力； 有感知 —— 系统级框架统一适配视觉、声学、IMU 等传感器件，感知数据即插即用，无需逐设备重复开发； 有交互 —— 从无屏到小屏再到大屏，分布式协同让交互界面随终端形态弹性伸缩。 而开源鸿蒙原生集成了联接、AI、图形等多项能力， 是千行百业轻智能升级的 OS 底座 。 据介绍，该平台将 星闪联接、端侧 AI、超高清音视频三大生态能力融入开源鸿蒙 ，通过芯片与操作系统的双向使能构筑核心竞争力，面向智慧家庭、消费电子、汽车电子三大产业场景，助力百亿量级 IoT 终端实现轻智能升级。 星闪“硬总线”与开源鸿蒙分布式“软总线”融合，形成软硬协同的互联互通底座； 端侧 NPU 推理、AI ISP 等能力下沉为系统级框架，让轻量终端原生具备 AI 运行环境； 超高清编解码、菁彩视听等音视频能力适配进系统媒体管线，让高品质视听体验直达终端。 ▲ 芯片能力注入 Hi-OHOS 平台能力
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov 28 that the 2026 OpenHarmony Technical Conference was held in Nanjing that day, where Shanghai HiSilicon highlighted Hi-OHOS, a unified OS platform built on OpenHarmony. According to the company, rebuilding billions of IoT terminals requires a set of system-native capabilities: connectivity — a distributed soft bus combined with the NearLink hard bus enabling cross-brand, cross-category device interconnection; compute — AI capabilities built into the system framework so even lightweight terminals have full AI capability; sensing — a system-level framework that uniformly adapts to vision, acoustic, IMU and other sensors so perception data is plug-and-play without repeated per-device development; and interaction — from no-screen to small screens to large screens, distributed collaboration lets interaction interfaces scale elastically with terminal form factors. OpenHarmony natively integrates connectivity, AI, graphics and other capabilities, making it an OS foundation for lightweight intelligence upgrades across industries. The platform integrates three ecosystem capabilities — NearLink connectivity, on-device AI, and ultra-high-definition audio-video — into OpenHarmony, building competitiveness through two-way enablement of chips and operating systems, targeting smart home, consumer electronics and automotive electronics to help billions of IoT terminals achieve lightweight intelligence upgrades: NearLink's 'hard bus' merges with OpenHarmony's distributed 'soft bus' to form a software-hardware interconnection foundation; on-device NPU inference, AI ISP and similar capabilities are pushed down to the system framework so lightweight terminals natively have an AI runtime environment; and ultra-HD codec, UWA audio-visual and other capabilities are adapted into the system media pipeline so high-quality audio-visual experiences reach terminals directly.
items.why_zh: 推测：把芯片级能力下沉到开源鸿蒙系统框架，可能影响轻量 IoT 终端的 AI 能力门槛，但实际落地效果尚需产品验证。
items.why_en: Speculative: pushing chip-level capabilities down into the OpenHarmony system framework could lower the AI capability bar for lightweight IoT terminals, though real-world results still need product validation.

items.title_en: RoboOH 2.0, First Embodied-Intelligence OS Built by OpenHarmony Community, Officially Released
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，2026 开源鸿蒙技术大会在南京举行。大会期间， 开源鸿蒙具身智能操作系统 RoboOH 2.0 Release 版本正式发布 。 该系统通过 RoboMaestro 系统级运行底座与 RoboFrame 本体抽象层两大核心组件，构建兼容多种技术路线、支持不同机器人本体的开放系统架构，为国产具身智能产业提供了一套自主可控、生态开放的系统级底座。 RoboOH 2.0 支持多模型推理、数据采集及机器人运动控制等能力， 覆盖双足、四足、轮式及旋翼等不同形态 。 IT之家了解到，大会还发布了开源鸿蒙设备平台 1.0 Release 及开源鸿蒙统一互联 3.0 Release。 前者支持 AI 辅助应用开发及芯片适配，可面向两轮车、家电等设备；后者拓展了跨厂商设备互联等能力 。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov 28 that the 2026 OpenHarmony Technical Conference was held in Nanjing, during which the RoboOH 2.0 Release, an embodied-intelligence operating system for OpenHarmony, was officially released. Through two core components — the RoboMaestro system-level runtime foundation and the RoboFrame body abstraction layer — the system builds an open architecture compatible with multiple technical approaches and supporting different robot bodies, providing China's embodied-intelligence industry with a self-controllable, ecosystem-open system-level foundation. RoboOH 2.0 supports multi-model inference, data collection and robot motion control, covering bipedal, quadrupedal, wheeled and rotor-based forms. IT之家 learned that the conference also released the OpenHarmony Device Platform 1.0 Release, which supports AI-assisted application development and chip adaptation for devices such as two-wheelers and home appliances, and the OpenHarmony Unified Connectivity 3.0 Release, which expands cross-vendor device interconnection capabilities.
items.why_zh: 推测：由开源社区主导的具身智能操作系统若被广泛采用，可能降低不同机器人本体的适配成本，但目前仍处发布阶段，生态采用情况未知。
items.why_en: Speculative: if widely adopted, a community-led embodied-intelligence OS could lower adaptation costs across different robot bodies, but it has only just been released and ecosystem uptake is unknown.

items.title_zh: 《黑神话：悟空》制作人冯骥：AI 正在改写一条数百年未变的硬边界，智力首次脱离肉身变资本要素
items.title_en: Feng Ji: AI Is Rewriting a Centuries-Old Hard Boundary as Intelligence Leaves the Body to Become a Capital Factor
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，11 月 27 日，游戏科学创始人 / CEO、《黑神话：悟空》制作人冯骥在其个人公众号“冯骥 Yocar”发表了一篇名为《 后 AI 时代最重要的问题 》的长文，全文约 8000 字。文章发出后，引发全网热议。 冯骥表示，最让自己忧心忡忡的，是 AI 正在改写一条数百年未变的硬边界 —— 智力在历史上第一次脱离肉身，从劳动要素变成了资本要素 。 他称，在此之前，无论多高深的学问、多老辣的判断与直觉，统统长在活生生的人脑里。只要长在肉身里，就摆脱不了生老病死； 任你天赋再高，一天真正的巅峰状态也就几个小时 。 人就是这样，困了要睡，病了要歇，受了委屈会辞职，作死…… 就会真死。 智力只绑在个体身上，没法复制粘贴，再吝啬的老板想把生意做大，也必须老老实实向千千万万受过教育的劳动者购买工时。 这道生理瓶颈，撑起了过去数百年普通人“勤学苦练 → 掌握技能 → 换取收入 → 获得尊重”的核心社会契约。 大模型出现之后，这道瓶颈被一点点砸碎了 。 据IT之家此前报道，今年 2 月，冯骥发文，谈及了刚上线即梦的 Seedance 2.0。他表示，AIGC 的童年时代，结束了。他坦言，自己在深感震撼的同时，也有一丝迷茫。 同时，冯骥当时还抛出了一个疑问：如果 AI 将把内容生产的卡尔达肖夫指数从 I 型提升到了 II 型文明，不是强 100 倍，而是强 100 亿倍，那会是个怎样的世界？
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov 28 that Feng Ji, founder and CEO of Game Science and producer of 'Black Myth: Wukong', published an roughly 8,000-word essay titled 'The Most Important Question in the Post-AI Era' on his personal WeChat account 'Feng Ji Yocar' on Nov 27, sparking wide discussion online. Feng said what worries him most is that AI is rewriting a hard boundary unchanged for centuries — for the first time in history, intelligence is detaching from the physical body and turning from a labor factor into a capital factor. He said that before this, no matter how profound the knowledge or how seasoned the judgment and intuition, it all grew in living human brains; anything that grows in a body cannot escape birth, aging, illness and death, and however gifted a person is, their true peak state lasts only a few hours a day. People are like this: tired, they sleep; ill, they rest; wronged, they resign; reckless, they truly die. items.title_en: World's Tallest Transmission Tower Gets First Maintenance in Jiangsu, With Exoskeleton Robots Assisting High-Altitude Work
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，11 月 28 日，位于江苏的 500 千伏凤城至梅里长江大跨越工程开展首次人工走线检修，外骨骼机器人首次投入这项高空作业。 据央视新闻报道，该工程是国内规模最大的超高压跨江输变电工程，承担着江苏北部清洁能源送往苏南用电负荷中心的任务，这也是世界最高输电铁塔的首次人工走线检修。 据江苏省送变电有限公司检修作业负责人郑熠珉介绍，这座铁塔长期运行在跨江高湿、多阵风环境中，随着运行时间积累，设备腐蚀、松动等隐患会慢慢滋生；冬季用电高峰临近，江苏电网保供压力加大，此次检修是保障跨江送电的重要一环。 走线人员登塔作业前，已依托大型无人机完成一轮巡检，并利用人工智能技术识别研判整个长江大跨越段的设备隐患，形成“隐患清单”，检修人员对照清单开展高空作业。 检修人员所在的平台距江面约 364 米，平均风力可达 5 级，阵风 6 至 7 级。脚下导线 直径仅 35mm ，江心段晃动最强，线路落差 260 米，全程 2550 米，走线需要近 4 小时。 郑熠珉介绍，本次检修首次应用外骨骼机器人，整套装备重 2.5 公斤，内置智能芯片，可通过 AI 实时识别人体步频、步幅并动态测算工况。人员在导线上屈膝、迈步、蹲坐时，装备向上托举支撑、向下辅助稳定， 最高可降低腰下肢 40% 的肌肉负荷 。 作业中还发现塔侧导线 25 号间隔棒线夹螺栓松动，检修人员当场处理。郑熠珉称，跨江档距长、江面风大，线夹螺栓会逐步松弛，因此需要走线检查，发现一处处理一处。报道称，本次检修预计 11 月 28 日下午全部完成。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov 28 that the 500 kV Fengcheng–Meili Yangtze River Crossing project in Jiangsu carried out its first manual conductor-walking maintenance that day, with exoskeleton robots deployed in the high-altitude work for the first time. According to CCTV News, the project is China's largest ultra-high-voltage river-crossing power transmission and transformation project, carrying clean energy from northern Jiangsu to load centers in southern Jiangsu, and this was the first manual conductor-walking maintenance of the world's tallest transmission tower. Zheng Yimin, head of maintenance operations at Jiangsu Electric Power Transmission and Transformation Co., said the tower has long operated in a high-humidity, gusty cross-river environment, and over time hazards such as equipment corrosion and loosening gradually develop; with the winter power peak approaching and greater supply-guarantee pressure on the Jiangsu grid, this maintenance is an important part of ensuring cross-river power transmission. Before climbing the tower, line walkers had already completed a round of inspection using large drones and used artificial intelligence to identify and assess equipment hazards across the entire Yangtze crossing section, forming a 'hazard list' that maintenance staff used for high-altitude work. The platform where the maintenance workers stand is about 364 meters above the river, with average winds of force 5 and gusts of force 6 to 7; the conductor underfoot is only 35 mm in diameter, sway is strongest mid-river, the line drops 260 meters over a total length of 2,550 meters, and walking the line takes nearly 4 hours. Zheng said this maintenance used exoskeleton robots for the first time: the 2.5 kg suit has built-in smart chips and uses AI to recognize step frequency and stride in real time and dynamically calculate working conditions; when workers bend, step or squat on the conductor, the equipment lifts and supports upward and stabilizes downward, reducing muscle load on the lower back and legs by up to 40%. During the work, a loose clamp bolt on spacer No. 25 on the tower-side conductor was found and fixed on the spot. Zheng said that with long cross-river spans and strong winds, clamp bolts gradually loosen, so line-walking inspections are needed to fix problems as they are found. The report said the maintenance was expected to be fully completed on the afternoon of Nov 28.

items.why_en: Speculative: the first use of exoskeletons and AI hazard identification in ultra-high-voltage cross-river maintenance may offer a reference case for human-machine collaboration in high-risk work at height, though the evidence comes from a single reported operation.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，11 月 27 日，游戏科学创始人、《黑神话：悟空》制作人冯骥在其个人公众号“冯骥 Yocar”发表了一篇名为《后 AI 时代最重要的问题》的长文，全文约 8000 字。文章发出后，引发全网热议。 冯骥在文章开篇提出了一个问题：当人工智能（AI）在生产端大规模取代人类劳动后，整个社会应该如何看待人的价值？他认为， 这就是后 AI 时代最重要的问题，没有之一 。 在他看来，这轮 AI 革命与历次工业革命有两点根本不同： 一是“迁徙的高地没了” 过去，机器替代的是肌肉与脚力，人从农田退进车间，从流水线退进写字楼，一路往更费脑子的高处搬家，新冒出来的行业往往有着更细的分工，更强的手脑并用。 今天算力正面攻占的就是脑力本身，我们身后并没有什么更高一层的“超脑力工种”可供几亿人集体转移。 新行业新赛道当然会出现，但它们未必会创造多少必须由人完成的任务。如果新增需求主要由 AI 承接，市场即便继续增长，普通人靠劳动分享增长的通道也可能越来越窄，甚至出现倒退。 ▲ 来源：Robert C. Allen（2009），《Engels’ pause》|“恩格斯停顿”：产出增长未能同步转化为工资增长。蓝线为每名工人的产出，粉线为实际工资 二是“淘汰的时钟加速了” 以前一项新技术铺开要磨上二三十年，慢到足够一代人熬到退休、下一代人从容转行。如今哪怕冒出个“提示词工程”或“智能体管理”之类的新饭碗，只要操作路径留在屏幕上变成训练数据，下一代模型再迭代一两个版本，就会把大部分精华吸收进默认能力。 模型吞掉新技能的速度，比人报班拿证快上一个数量级。 门外的 AI 几个月重写下一代的自己，门里的孩子还在重复小学、中学、大学的二十年培养周期。 人还没上跑道，终点已经无了。 关于如果有一天，部分、甚至绝大部分的“劳动”都被 AI 替代了，应该怎么分配？冯骥认为：“真到了‘后 AI 时代’，我能想到最公平的底线，是从这部分‘由 AI 而非人类劳动’创造的超额社会财富中，提取公共红利，按人头平均分配。” 他提出，在坚持按劳分配为主体的前提下，把未来由 AI 替代人工创造的超额物质财富，平等地普惠每个人。 他还主张，当 AI 取代绝大多数人类劳动、抹平人与人在生产端的个体差异之后，社会不能再只以生产端的贡献去衡量人的价值。人不是生产的手段，人只能是生产的目的。 每一个人都同样生而高贵，AI 创造的基础物质丰裕，理应通过全民分红，平等地惠及每一个人 。 IT之家注意到，文章最后，冯骥还写下： 去死吧，赛博朋克。 去死吧，黑暗启蒙。 每个人自由发展的时代，必将到来！ 冯骥《后 AI 时代最重要的问题》全文如下：
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 28: On Nov 27, Game Science founder and Black Myth: Wukong producer Feng Ji published an approximately 8,000-word essay titled 'The Most Important Question of the Post-AI Era' on his personal WeChat account 'Feng Ji Yocar,' which sparked widespread discussion online. The essay opens by asking how society should view human value once AI replaces human labor at scale on the production side; he calls this the most important question of the post-AI era, bar none. He argues this AI revolution differs fundamentally from earlier industrial revolutions in two ways. First, 'the higher ground to migrate to is gone': previously machines replaced muscle and footwork, and people moved from fields to workshops, from assembly lines to offices, ever toward more brain-intensive work; today computing power is attacking brainpower itself, and there is no higher tier of 'super-brainwork' jobs for hundreds of millions to move into collectively. New industries and tracks will appear, but they may not create many tasks that must be done by humans; if new demand is mainly absorbed by AI, the channel through which ordinary people share growth via labor may narrow or even reverse even if the market keeps growing (the essay cites a Robert C. Allen (2009) chart on the 'Engels' pause,' where output growth failed to translate into wage growth). Second, 'the clock of obsolescence has accelerated': new technologies once took 20-30 years to spread, long enough for one generation to retire and the next to change careers; now, new jobs such as 'prompt engineering' or 'agent management' can be largely absorbed into default model capabilities after one or two model iterations once the operational path is captured on screen as training data — models swallow new skills an order of magnitude faster than people can take courses and earn certificates. On how to distribute when some or even most 'labor' is replaced by AI, Feng says the fairest baseline he can imagine is to extract a public dividend from the excess social wealth created 'by AI rather than human labor' and distribute it equally per capita; while maintaining distribution according to work as the main principle, excess material wealth created by AI replacing human labor should be shared equally by everyone. He also argues that once AI erases individual differences on the production side, society can no longer measure human value only by production-side contributions: 'Humans are not the means of production; humans can only be the end of production.' The essay concludes: 'To hell with cyberpunk. To hell with the Dark Enlightenment. The era of everyone's free development will surely come!'

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，据华为数字能源分享，在联合国工业发展组织 60 周年纪念活动期间，雅砻江流域水电开发有限公司（简称“雅砻江公司”）与华为联合打造的“AI 赋能绿色能源方案”荣获“2026 年全球可持续工业 AI 解决方案奖”。 ▲ 雅砻江公司与华为联合荣获“2026 年全球可持续工业 AI 解决方案奖” 据介绍，该奖项由联合国工业发展组织（UNIDO）、联合国贸易和发展会议（UNCTAD）、联合国数字与新兴技术办公室（ODET）、国际电信联盟（ITU）、联合国发展协调办公室（UNDCO）以及世界机器人合作组织（WRCO）面向全球首次发起， 共收到来自 61 个国家 220 余份提案 。 雅砻江公司与华为联合打造的“AI 赋能绿色能源方案”从中脱颖而出。 该方案落地于世界级流域型清洁能源大基地标杆 —— 雅砻江柯拉光伏电站 。 参考IT之家此前报道，2023 年 6 月，雅砻江两河口水电站水光互补一期项目 —— 位于四川省甘孜藏族自治州雅江县柯拉乡的柯拉光伏电站并网发电，标志着全球首个百万千瓦级“水光互补”电站正式投产。 公开资料显示， 雅砻江柯拉光伏电站是全球最大、海拔最高的水光互补电站 。 该项目首次将全球“水光互补”项目规模提升至百万千瓦级 。电站通过 500kV 输电线路接入 50 公里外的两河口水电站，实现光伏发电和水电的“打捆”送出。电站投产后年平均发电量 20 亿度，每年可节约标准煤超 60 万吨、减少二氧化碳排放超 160 万吨。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 28: According to Huawei Digital Power, during the 60th anniversary events of the United Nations Industrial Development Organization, the 'AI-empowered Green Energy Solution' jointly developed by Yalong River Hydropower Development Co., Ltd. (Yalong River Company) and Huawei won the '2026 Global Sustainable Industrial AI Solution Award.' The award was launched globally for the first time by UNIDO, UNCTAD, the UN Office of Digital and Emerging Technologies (ODET), the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), the UN Development Coordination Office (UNDCO) and the World Robot Cooperation Organization (WRCO), and received more than 220 proposals from 61 countries; the joint Yalong River–Huawei solution was selected. The solution is deployed at the Yalong River Kela photovoltaic power station. IT Home previously reported that in June 2023, the Kela PV station — phase one of the hydro-photovoltaic complementary project of the Yalong River Lianghekou hydropower station, located in Kela township, Yajiang county, Garzê Tibetan autonomous prefecture, Sichuan — was connected to the grid, marking the official commissioning of the world's first million-kilowatt-class hydro-photovoltaic complementary station. Public materials show the Kela station is the world's largest and highest-altitude hydro-photovoltaic complementary station, raising the scale of such projects to the million-kilowatt level for the first time; it connects via a 500kV transmission line to the Lianghekou hydropower station 50 km away, sending bundled PV and hydro power. After commissioning, the station's average annual generation is 2 billion kWh, saving more than 600,000 tonnes of standard coal and cutting more than 1.6 million tonnes of CO2 emissions per year.
items.why_zh: 若奖项与落地情况属实，说明 AI 在能源等工业场景的应用正获国际机构关注，但方案实际效果尚未披露（推测）。
items.why_en: If the award and deployment are as described, it suggests AI applications in energy and other industrial settings are drawing international institutional attention, though the solution's actual performance has not been disclosed (speculative).

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，上汽荣威今日宣布，家越 07 大定锁单突破 35,000 台，全系搭载豆包座舱助手。 据IT之家此前报道，家越 07 于 10 月 23 日上市，限时权益价 11.98 万元起；家越 07 纯电版于 11 月 27 日上市，限时权益价 13.28 万元起。 车型 指导价（万元） 限时权益价（万元） 220 智享版 12.78 11.98 220 激光雷达版 13.78 12.98 320 激光雷达版 14.58 13.78 320 激光雷达智尊版 15.28 14.48 651 智享版 14.08 13.28 651 激光雷达版 15.08 14.28 651 激光雷达智尊版 15.78 14.98 该车长宽高为 4900*1910*1745mm，轴距 2908mm；行业首搭豆包座舱助手，搭载最新 Momenta R7 世界模型。 增程版配备 32.6kWh 和 44.2kWh 两种容量的电池组，纯电续航分别为 220km 和 320km，最大综合续航 1480km。 纯电版标配 800V 碳化硅平台，80.6kWh 电池，续航 651km，电机峰值功率达 245kW，峰值扭矩达 430N·m ，零百加速 5.9 秒。 相关阅读： 《 限时权益价 11.98 万元起，上汽荣威家越 07 汽车上市 》 《 荣威家越 07 纯电版上市：行业首搭豆包座舱助手，13.28 万元起 》
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 28: SAIC Roewe announced today that locked orders for the Jiayue 07 have exceeded 35,000 units, and all trims come with the Doubao cockpit assistant. IT Home previously reported that the Jiayue 07 launched on Oct 23 with a limited-time promotional price from 119,800 yuan, and the Jiayue 07 EV launched on Nov 27 with a limited-time promotional price from 132,800 yuan. Listed price/limited-time price (10,000 yuan): 220 Smart Enjoy 12.78/11.98; 220 LiDAR 13.78/12.98; 320 LiDAR 14.58/13.78; 320 LiDAR Premium 15.28/14.48; 651 Smart Enjoy 14.08/13.28; 651 LiDAR 15.08/14.28; 651 LiDAR Premium 15.78/14.98. The car measures 4900*1910*1745mm with a 2908mm wheelbase; it is the industry's first to feature the Doubao cockpit assistant and carries the latest Momenta R7 world model. The range-extender version offers 32.6kWh and 44.2kWh battery packs with 220km and 320km of electric range respectively and up to 1,480km combined range. The EV version standardizes an 800V silicon-carbide platform and an 80.6kWh battery, with 651km of range, a 245kW peak motor output and 430N·m peak torque, and 0-100km/h acceleration in 5.9 seconds.

items.title_en: Lenovo Lecoo Exoskeleton Robot Walker ONE Goes on Sale: 1.8kg Magnesium Alloy Body, 6,999 Yuan
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，联想来酷外骨骼机器人行者 ONE 今日正式开售， 售价 6999 元 。 这款产品是一款面向老人出行、户外徒步、上下楼锻炼场景的穿戴式助行设备，采用 1.8kg 镁合金机身，帮助缓解下肢行走负担。 动力方面，来酷行者 ONE 采用双髋独立驱动设计，单边输出 19N·m、双边合计 38N·m 峰值扭矩，峰值功率达 900W，助行效率 ≥45%，可在爬楼、户外登山等场景下降低体能消耗。 机身结构上，产品前后活动角度 ≥170°、侧向活动角度 ≥20°，反向阻尼 <1N·m；采用人体工学 3 点舒适承托设计帮助分散局部压力，3 点扣锁 15 秒即可利落穿脱。 来酷行者 ONE 标配 2×3000mAh 可拆卸双电池，双电池下续航可达 8 小时，单电池 3 档助力下约 3 小时；支持快拆更换无需脱下整机，配备 Type-C 接口可使用充电宝随时补能；防护等级为 IP54，可应对日常防尘防溅水。 IT之家附这款产品主要参数： 京东 来酷行者 ONE 外骨骼机器人 6999 元 直达链接
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 28: Lenovo Lecoo's exoskeleton robot Walker ONE officially went on sale today at 6,999 yuan. The product is a wearable walking-assist device for elderly mobility, outdoor hiking and stair-climbing exercise, featuring a 1.8kg magnesium alloy body that helps relieve lower-limb walking burden. On power, it uses a dual-hip independent drive design with 19N·m output per side, 38N·m combined peak torque, 900W peak power and walking-assist efficiency of ≥45%, reducing energy expenditure when climbing stairs or hiking. Structurally, it offers ≥170° front-back range of motion, ≥20° lateral range, and reverse damping <1N·m; an ergonomic 3-point support design spreads local pressure, and a 3-point buckle lets users put it on or take it off in 15 seconds. It comes standard with 2×3000mAh detachable batteries, up to 8 hours of battery life with both and about 3 hours on one at level-3 assistance; batteries can be swapped quickly without removing the device, a Type-C port allows power-bank charging, and IP54 rating handles everyday dust and splashes.
items.why_zh: 若产品按所述规格交付，消费级外骨骼价格下探至 7000 元档，可能推动助行设备从专业场景进入家庭日常（推测）。
items.why_en: If the product delivers as specified, consumer exoskeletons reaching the ~7,000-yuan range could push walking-assist devices from professional settings into everyday home use (speculative).

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，首款为 AI 而生的鸿蒙手机 —— 华为星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 已于 11 月 20 日下午正式发布 ，叠加国补后 4999 元起。华为星芒品牌总经理刘赫也已开通微博，持续解答网友疑惑。 ▲ IT之家开箱：华为全新子品牌星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 手机实拍 针对近日关于星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 开售 3 天首销激活销量约 4700 台的爆料，刘赫回应：“ 呵呵，不予置评。 ” 参考IT之家此前报道，OSTA O1 Pro 提供星芒紫、星云白、星空黑三款配色；配备一块 6.39 英寸 16:9.5 比例 1.5K LTPS 直屏；后置 200Mp 1/1.28" RYYB 主摄 + 50Mp 3.7X RYYB 潜望长焦 + 红枫镜头。 新机还搭载麒麟 9030S 旗舰 τ 芯片，提供至高 16GB+1TB 规格可选，手机内置 7000mAh 电池，支持 66W 有线充电 + 无线充电；首发搭载 HarmonyOS 7 AI 先锋版，支持全新 AI 交互、系统主动智能和长期陪伴成长。 延伸阅读 华为全新子品牌 OSTA 星芒于 2026 年 11 月 20 日在鸿蒙智行享界 V8 及星芒品牌发布会上正式发布，品牌总经理刘赫也在该发布会上首次登台亮相。据官方介绍，OSTA 取自 Original（原创）、Smart（智能）、Technology（科技）、Accessible（触手可及）四个关键词的首字母。 星芒以“Come As You Are，自有光芒”为品牌口号，定位面向 AI 浪潮下愿意尝鲜、敢于表达、追求同频对话的先锋人群，聚焦中高端市场，并不走低价走量的路线。华为常务董事、终端 BG 董事长余承东表示，星芒将主打原创、智能、科技和触手可及等特性。 在华为终端版图中，OSTA 星芒与“HUAWEI”品牌构成并列的双品牌架构的另一极，两者差异化定位、互补发展，共享麒麟芯片、鸿蒙操作系统、昆仑玻璃、红枫影像等技术底座与品质标准。外界曾将星芒解读为“第二个荣耀”，但有分析认为，星芒接到的并非冲出货量的任务，现阶段更侧重建立品牌认知、培育用户并验证新的 AI 技术与产品体验。 关于首销激活量约 4700 台的说法，来自数码博主 @数码闲聊站，其统计周期为 W47，即 2026 年 11 月 16 日至 11 月 22 日。 OSTA O1 Pro 提供 12GB+256GB、12GB+512GB、16GB+512GB 和 16GB+1TB 四个版本，首发价分别为 5499 元、6499 元、7299 元和 8799 元。该机与华为 Pura X View 均采用麒麟 9030S 芯片和 6.39 英寸阔直屏，不过 O1 Pro 未配备超广角镜头，起售价较后者低 500 元，并提供后者没有的 16GB 运行内存版本。 针对价格质疑，刘赫此前曾在微博评论区回应称，他宁愿先把产品做好一点，“便宜未必是创新的方向”，并表示星芒选择创新优先；他还提到 O1 Pro 的 16GB 版本开售当天已在全平台售罄，部分线下门店供货偏少。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 28: The first HarmonyOS phone built for AI — Huawei's Stellar (OSTA) O1 Pro — officially launched on the afternoon of Nov 20, priced from 4,999 yuan after national subsidies. Liu He, general manager of the Huawei Stellar brand, has opened a Weibo account to answer users' questions. Asked about recent leaks that the OSTA O1 Pro recorded about 4,700 first-sale activations in its first three days on sale, Liu responded: 'Heh, no comment.' IT Home previously reported that the OSTA O1 Pro comes in Stellar Purple, Nebula White and Starry Black; it has a 6.39-inch 16:9.5 1.5K LTPS flat display; a rear 200MP 1/1.28" RYYB main camera + 50MP 3.7X RYYB periscope telephoto + Red Maple lens; a Kirin 9030S flagship τ chip, up to 16GB+1TB configurations, a 7,000mAh battery, 66W wired plus wireless charging; and it debuts HarmonyOS 7 AI Pioneer Edition with new AI interaction, proactive system intelligence and long-term companion growth. The ~4,700 activation figure came from digital blogger @数码闲聊站, covering week W47 (Nov 16-22, 2026). The OSTA O1 Pro comes in 12GB+256GB, 12GB+512GB, 16GB+512GB and 16GB+1TB versions priced at 5,499, 6,499, 7,299 and 8,799 yuan respectively. Liu previously addressed pricing criticism by saying he would rather make the product better first, that 'cheap is not necessarily the direction of innovation,' and that the 16GB version sold out across platforms on launch day, with some offline stores receiving limited stock.
items.why_zh: 高管对第三方销量爆料不予置评，说明该数据尚未获公司确认；其对销量的真实含义仍待观察（推测）。
items.why_en: The executive's refusal to comment means the third-party sales figure is not confirmed by the company, and what it actually implies about demand remains to be seen (speculative).

items.title_zh: 我国太空数据中心在轨技术试验平台上线
items.title_en: China's Space Data Center On-Orbit Technology Test Platform Goes Live
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，据北京发布今日消息，11 月 27 日，2026 太空数据中心建设工作推进大会举行，大会公布了北京太空算力工作进展， 并发布了太空数据中心在轨技术试验平台 。 据介绍，太空数据中心在轨技术试验平台正式上线，平台依托超大功率太空数据中心首发技术试验星 —— 辰光一号 01 星构建，标志着辰光一号 01 星在圆满完成既定在轨测试任务后，转入在轨试验服务阶段。 今年 7 月 24 日发射入轨后，它已稳定运行超 4 个月，在轨提供 25000TOPS 算力，部署 4 个专业模型和 2 个通用大模型完成在轨推理。这个平台将面向高校、科研院所、企业等单位提供在轨算力和模型试验机会。 “辰光一号”就是北京建设太空数据中心的第一块积木 。北京星辰未来空间技术研究院院长张善从说，经过 4 个多月的在轨试验，一个最重要的结论是： 集中式太空数据中心建设初步可行 。目前，太空算力星座建设有分布式小算力和集中式大数据中心两条技术路线，星空院主张的是单一规模至少百千瓦的集中式路线。“ 辰光一号”验证的，正是这条路线从原理到工程的关键一步 。 据IT之家此前报道，太空数据中心是解决人工智能时代算力瓶颈的重要举措，也是推进商业航天实现商业闭环的重要一步。地面数据中心发展会受限于占地、供电、散热等问题，而太空数据中心没有这些烦恼。 根据规划， 太空数据中心将部署在距地面 700 至 800 公里的晨昏轨道 ，建设过程分为“天数天算”“地数天算”“天基主算”三个阶段。项目采用模块化、标准化设计，通过在轨交会对接搭建平方公里级大型航天器，最终具备超大模型训练与推理能力。 今年 7 月 24 日 07 时 33 分，中科宇航力箭一号遥十五运载火箭在东风商业航天创新试验区发射，采用“一箭 5 星”的方式， 将“辰光一号卫星”等 5 颗卫星精准送入预定轨道 ，发射任务取得圆满成功，开启下半年逐月常态化发射，形成可靠高效的密集发射能力。 相关阅读： 《 北京将建“太空数据中心”，首颗算力试验卫星“辰光一号”即将发射 》 《 中科宇航：力箭一号圆满完成“一箭 5 星”任务，开启下半年逐月常态化发射 》
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 28: According to 'Beijing Fabu' today, the 2026 Space Data Center Construction Work Promotion Conference was held on Nov 27, reporting progress on Beijing's space computing efforts and releasing the space data center on-orbit technology test platform. The platform, now online, is built on Chenguang-1 01, the first technology test satellite for an ultra-high-power space data center, marking the satellite's transition from completed in-orbit testing to an in-orbit trial service phase. Since its launch on July 24 this year, it has operated stably for more than four months, providing 25,000 TOPS of in-orbit computing power and running in-orbit inference with four specialized models and two general large models. The platform will offer in-orbit computing power and model testing opportunities to universities, research institutes and enterprises. Zhang Shancong, president of the Beijing Xingchen Future Space Technology Research Institute, said Chenguang-1 is 'the first building block' of Beijing's space data center, and that the most important conclusion from over four months of in-orbit testing is that building a centralized space data center is preliminarily feasible. Space computing constellations currently follow two technical routes — distributed small computing power and centralized large data centers — and the institute advocates the centralized route with at least 100 kilowatts per unit; Chenguang-1 verifies a key step of this route from principle to engineering. IT Home previously reported that space data centers are seen as an important measure to address AI-era computing bottlenecks and a step toward a commercial closed loop for the space industry; ground data centers are constrained by land, power supply and cooling, which space data centers avoid. Under the plan, the space data center will be deployed in a dawn-dusk orbit 700-800 km above ground, built in three phases — 'computing in space, computing for space,' 'ground data, space computing' and 'space-based primary computing' — using modular, standardized designs and in-orbit rendezvous and docking to assemble square-kilometer-class large spacecraft, ultimately enabling training and inference of very large models. At 07:33 on July 24 this year, CAS Space's Lijian-1 Y15 rocket launched from the Dongfeng commercial space innovation test zone, sending five satellites including Chenguang-1 into their planned orbits in a 'one rocket, five satellites' mission.
items.why_zh: 若在轨试验结论可靠，则意味着集中式太空算力路线从原理走向工程验证，或影响未来 AI 算力基础设施布局（推测）。
items.why_en: If the in-orbit test conclusions hold, the centralized space-computing route is moving from principle to engineering validation, which could shape future AI computing infrastructure planning (speculative).

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，首款为 AI 而生的鸿蒙手机 —— 华为星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 已于 11 月 20 日下午正式发布 ，叠加国补后 4999 元起。华为星芒品牌总经理刘赫也已开通微博，持续解答网友疑惑。 ▲ IT之家开箱：华为全新子品牌星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 手机实拍 有网友昨日在刘赫微博评论区反馈，领取补贴想在华为商城购买新机时，却遇到了断货问题。对此，刘赫当晚回应称：“ 在补货了，这两天整的鸡飞狗跳... ” 截至发文， 华为星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 手机在华为商城、京东等平台均可正常购买 ，支持现货发货、至高 12 期 0 分期利息。 作为参考，博主 @数码闲聊站 昨日发文爆料，某厂 O1 Pro（预计指华为星芒 OSTA O1 Pro）开售 3 天，首销激活销量约 4700 台（统计周期为 W47 | 11 月 16 日-11 月 22 日）。 另据IT之家此前报道，OSTA O1 Pro 提供星芒紫、星云白、星空黑三款配色；配备一块 6.39 英寸 16:9.5 比例 1.5K LTPS 直屏；后置 200Mp 1/1.28" RYYB 主摄 + 50Mp 3.7X RYYB 潜望长焦 + 红枫镜头。 新机还搭载麒麟 9030S 旗舰 τ 芯片，提供至高 16GB+1TB 规格可选，手机内置 7000mAh 电池，支持 66W 有线充电 + 无线充电；首发搭载 HarmonyOS 7 AI 先锋版，支持全新 AI 交互、系统主动智能和长期陪伴成长。 京东 华为 OSTA 星芒 O1 Pro 鸿蒙 AI 手机 首发国补价 4999 元起 直达链接 相关阅读： 《 5499 元起，“首款为 AI 而生的鸿蒙手机”华为星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 阔直板正式发布 》
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov. 28: The first HarmonyOS phone built for AI, the Huawei Xingmang OSTA O1 Pro, was officially launched on the afternoon of Nov. 20, starting at 4,999 yuan after the national subsidy. Liu He, general manager of the Huawei Xingmang brand, has opened a Weibo account and continues to answer users' questions. Yesterday, a user commented on Liu He's Weibo that after receiving the subsidy, they tried to buy the new phone on Huawei Mall but encountered a stockout. Liu He responded that night: 'Restocking, it's been chaotic these two days...' As of publication, the Huawei Xingmang OSTA O1 Pro is available for normal purchase on Huawei Mall, JD.com and other platforms, with in-stock shipping and up to 12 interest-free installments. Blogger @数码闲聊站 posted yesterday that a certain manufacturer's O1 Pro (expected to refer to the Huawei Xingmang OSTA O1 Pro) had about 4,700 first-sale activation units in its first three days on sale (statistical period W47, Nov. 16–Nov. 22). The OSTA O1 Pro comes in Xingmang Purple, Nebula White and Starry Black; it features a 6.39-inch 16:9.5 1.5K LTPS flat display; a 200MP 1/1.28\" RYYB main camera + 50MP 3.7X RYYB periscope telephoto + Red Maple lens. The phone also carries the Kirin 9030S flagship τ chip, offers up to 16GB+1TB, has a 7,000mAh battery, supports 66W wired charging + wireless charging, and debuts HarmonyOS 7 AI Pioneer Edition with new AI interaction, proactive system intelligence and long-term companion growth.
items.why_zh: 推测：断货与补货回应显示新机首销需求与供应节奏受到关注，但首销激活销量来自博主爆料，未获官方确认。
items.why_en: Speculation: The stockout and restocking response suggest first-sale demand and supply cadence are drawing attention, but the activation sales figure comes from a blogger's claim and is not officially confirmed.

items.summary_en: The Honor Earbuds clip-on earphones were officially launched on Nov. 23, featuring Hi-Res gold-standard audio and about 40 hours of combined battery life. The official suggested retail price is 499 yuan; today, with the national subsidy, they are 339 yuan, a new low. A 10 yuan E-card rebate for a review brings the effective price to 329 yuan. A 50 yuan coupon is available first. Many creators have made comparison videos between these earphones and the Huawei FreeClip2. The earphones come in Starry Black and Pearl White, with dedicated accessory charms. Each earbud weighs 5.6g, with about 10 hours of single-charge battery life and about 40 hours combined. The Honor Earbuds clip-on earphones support cross-ecosystem device adaptation and include features such as an ear-side AI assistant. They use a soft, secure C-bridge design with food-grade skin-friendly silicone for all-day comfort. They carry a dual-magnetic-circuit titanium-coated dynamic driver of the same class as flagship earphones, Hi-Res gold-standard audio, and support LHDC 5.0 lossless format.

items.title_zh: 全新实景视图特斯拉 FSD v15 不再独有，小米汽车世界模型 2.0 实时渲染能力公开
items.title_en: New Reality View no longer exclusive to Tesla FSD v15: Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0 real-time rendering capabilities revealed
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息， 特斯拉 11 月 22 日宣布在美国市场推出 FSD v15 ，并向早期体验计划（EAP）成员推送首批版本。本次更新对安全关键场景的处理能力宣称提升了 25 倍，同时带来了全新可视化界面 ——“Tesla Reality View”（实景视图）。 昨日， 小米汽车正式发布 Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0 （小米汽车世界模型 2.0）。官方宣称小米汽车世界模型 2.0 进一步将多视角视频生成、物理交互建模、三维场景重建与动作建模连接起来，为辅助驾驶和具身智能统一因果世界模型带来新的范式。 据介绍，模型支持 1—7 路摄像头视角，训练语料规模达到 1,260 万段视频片段，并展示了从辅助驾驶、机器人场景生成，到闭环仿真与 World Action Model 的多项结果，在多个主流基准测试中全面取得 SOTA，并已在小米汽车合成数据、仿真测试等核心场景完成业务落地应用。 IT之家注意到， 小米汽车官方昨日还放出了世界模型 2.0 在 SR 路面感知系统渲染方面的效果 （视频从上到下依次为 SR 路面感知系统、小米汽车世界模型 2.0 和车载前视摄像头实拍。中间的车外视角由小米汽车世界模型 2.0 基于测试车采集的数据生成）： 路口等待红绿灯 道路行驶中 小米汽车世界模型 2.0 在 SR 路面感知系统渲染效果截图如下： 据介绍，小米汽车世界模型 2.0 通过大规模多源数据学习视觉与物理动态先验，通过多视角与时间建模理解场景演化，通过 WorldRec 2.0 建立持久三维场景上下文，并借助流式生成和蒸馏提升长时序推理效率。小米汽车世界模型 2.0 已在小米汽车实际业务场景中落地： 合成数据生成：已交付超过 20 万 clips 高质量合成数据，直接用于感知模型 / 感知基模训练，提升车辆在危险场景下的识别能力。 仿真测试：构建闭环仿真环境，优化测试效率，完备测试规范，可在仿真中复现真实事故并进行定向优化。 小米汽车持续研发推进预训练与闭环训练范式，推动端到端模型的认知能力跃升。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov. 28: Tesla announced on Nov. 22 that it is launching FSD v15 in the U.S. market and pushing the first versions to Early Access Program (EAP) members. The update claims a 25-fold improvement in handling safety-critical scenarios and brings a new visualization interface, 'Tesla Reality View.' Yesterday, Xiaomi Auto officially released Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0. It claims that Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0 further connects multi-view video generation, physical interaction modeling, 3D scene reconstruction and action modeling, bringing a new paradigm for a unified causal world model for assisted driving and embodied intelligence. The model supports 1–7 camera views, has a training corpus of 12.6 million video clips, and demonstrates results ranging from assisted driving and robot scene generation to closed-loop simulation and World Action Model; it claims state-of-the-art results across multiple mainstream benchmarks and has been deployed in core business scenarios such as Xiaomi Auto's synthetic data and simulation testing. Xiaomi Auto also released the rendering results of World Model 2.0 in the SR road perception system (in the video, from top to bottom: SR road perception system, Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0, and actual front-camera footage; the middle exterior view is generated by Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0 based on data collected by the test vehicle). According to the company, Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0 learns visual and physical dynamics priors from large-scale multi-source data, understands scene evolution through multi-view and temporal modeling, establishes persistent 3D scene context through WorldRec 2.0, and improves long-sequence reasoning efficiency through streaming generation and distillation. Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0 has been deployed in actual Xiaomi Auto business scenarios: in synthetic data generation, it has delivered more than 200,000 clips of high-quality synthetic data, directly used for perception model/perception foundation model training to improve vehicle recognition in dangerous scenarios; in simulation testing, it builds a closed-loop simulation environment to optimize testing efficiency, complete test specifications, reproduce real accidents in simulation and carry out targeted optimization. Xiaomi Auto continues to advance pretraining and closed-loop training paradigms to improve the cognitive capabilities of end-to-end models.
items.why_zh: 推测：小米公开世界模型 2.0 的渲染与仿真落地，显示车企在自动驾驶世界模型上的竞争加剧；但“SOTA”等为官方宣称，未经独立验证。
items.why_en: Speculation: Xiaomi's disclosure of World Model 2.0 rendering and simulation deployment suggests intensifying automaker competition in autonomous-driving world models; however, claims such as 'SOTA' are official statements and have not been independently verified.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 28 日消息，吉利银河今日宣布银河 M7 远航家将于 11 月 30 日加新上市，纯电续航至高 251km，综合续航至高 1756km。 IT之家注意到，吉利银河 M7 于 4 月 28 日正式上市，该车共推出 4 款配置车型，限时指导价下探至 10.98 万元起，价格如下： 车型 官方指导价（万元） 限时指导价（万元） 225km 远航版 11.98 10.98 225km 领航版 12.78 11.78 225km 探索 + 版 13.78 12.78 225km 星舰版 14.78 13.78 作为参考，银河 M7 定位于紧凑型插电式混合动力 SUV，其核心亮点在于采用了 2025 年发布的 GEA Evo 架构。新车长宽高分别为 4770 毫米、1905 毫米、1685 毫米， 轴距达到 2785 毫米 。 银河 M7 中控提供观山灰、观山灰翻毛皮版、栖霞橙、静湖白四种可选。15.4 英寸 2.5K 中控屏搭载 Flyme Auto 2 智能座舱系统，内置 7 纳米制程龙鹰一号芯片，支持卡片式交互界面、Hi Eva 语音车控，并依托星睿大模型实现全场景 AI 对话。 智能驾驶方面，银河 M7 搭载千里浩瀚 H3 方案，具备高速及高架 NOA 导航辅助驾驶能力，支持自动超车、上下匝道、拨杆变道等功能；全场景泊车辅助可识别超过 300 种车位类型，实现自动泊入与泊出。 银河 M7 动力系统由 1.5L 雷神 EM 超级电混发动机与前置单电机组成，发动机最大功率 82 千瓦，热效率达 47.26%；电机最大功率 175 千瓦，峰值扭矩 262 牛 · 米。电池采用神盾金砖磷酸铁锂电池，提供 29.8 千瓦时一种容量，对应 CLTC 纯电续航 225 公里，0 至 100 公里每小时加速时间为 7.7 秒。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov. 28: Geely Galaxy today announced that the Galaxy M7 Voyager will add a new model on Nov. 30, with pure-electric range up to 251 km and combined range up to 1,756 km. The Geely Galaxy M7 was officially launched on Apr. 28 with four trims, with limited-time guide prices starting at 109,800 yuan: the 225km Voyager Edition has an official guide price of 119,800 yuan and a limited-time guide price of 109,800 yuan; the 225km Pilot Edition 127,800 yuan and 117,800 yuan; the 225km Explore+ Edition 137,800 yuan and 127,800 yuan; the 225km Starship Edition 147,800 yuan and 137,800 yuan. The Galaxy M7 is positioned as a compact plug-in hybrid SUV, with its core highlight being the GEA Evo architecture released in 2025. Its dimensions are 4,770 mm long, 1,905 mm wide and 1,685 mm high, with a wheelbase of 2,785 mm. The Galaxy M7 interior offers Guanshan Gray, Guanshan Gray suede, Qixia Orange and Jinghu White. The 15.4-inch 2.5K central screen runs the Flyme Auto 2 smart cockpit system with a 7nm Dragon Eagle No. 1 chip, supports a card-based interface and Hi Eva voice vehicle control, and relies on the Xingrui large model for full-scenario AI dialogue. For intelligent driving, the Galaxy M7 adopts the Qianli Haohan H3 solution, with highway and elevated-road NOA navigation-assisted driving, supporting automatic overtaking, on/off ramps and lane change via stalk; full-scenario parking assistance can recognize more than 300 parking space types and achieve automatic parking in and out. The Galaxy M7 powertrain consists of a 1.5L Thor EM super hybrid engine and a front single motor; the engine has a maximum power of 82 kW and thermal efficiency of 47.26%; the motor has a maximum power of 175 kW and peak torque of 262 N·m. The battery uses ShenDun Golden Brick lithium iron phosphate battery with a single capacity of 29.8 kWh, corresponding to CLTC pure-electric range of 225 km, and 0–100 km/h acceleration of 7.7 seconds.

items.summary_zh: 随心所欲制作小组件。| 图片：Allison Johnson / The Verge 除了处理日历之外，我想让 AI 做一件事：告诉我是不是快错过公交车了。我需要一个小组件，能实时显示我家附近公交站的到站信息。在手机屏幕上到处点开正确的应用再选择站点，会慢到让我错过公交。我需要一眼可见的信息，于是寄希望于 Android 的“氛围编程”（vibe-coded）小组件功能。失望的是，它没能帮上忙，不过我制作其他小组件的过程还是挺有意思的。谷歌在今年春天的 I/O 大会上宣布了用 AI 创建自定义小组件的能力，名为 Create My Widget，它…… 全文请见 The Verge。
items.summary_en: Widgets, your way. | Photo: Allison Johnson / The Verge Aside from dealing with my calendar , there's one thing I want AI to do: tell me if I'm about to miss the bus. What I need is a widget. It needs to tell me real-time arrivals for the bus stop near my house. Tapping around on my phone screen to open the right app and select my stop will slow me down enough to miss a bus. I need glanceable information, and I hoped that Android's vibe-coded widget feature could help me out here. It hasn't, to my disappointment, but I still had a good time cooking up other widgets. items.why_zh: 推测：作者想用 AI 小组件解决实时公交到站的需求却未成功，说明平台级 AI 生成界面在数据接入与实际可用性上仍有局限。
items.why_en: Speculative: the author's failure to get a bus-arrival widget out of the AI widget tool suggests platform-level AI-generated interfaces still face limits in data access and real-world usability.
